narration.script: Why do wooden barrels bulge in the middle? [[slnc 350]] That curve has a name: [[slnc 150]] the [[emph +]] bilge. [[slnc 350]] Iron hoops squeeze the bent staves tight. [[slnc 250]] And the bulge makes a heavy barrel easy to roll [[slnc 150]] and easy to turn, right on the spot.

beats.purpose: Pose the question while the viewer discovers the barrel's shape

shots.purpose: Rise from floor level so the barrel's silhouette builds up and its widest point arrives on 'bulge'
shots.subject: barrel

shots.purpose: Drop to eye level on the barrel's outer edge and swing round so the bulging curve becomes a silhouette against the dark wall as it is named
shots.subject: barrel

transition.motivation: New information (the name) gets a new view: from the whole barrel to its curving edge

beats.purpose: Show what holds the curve: hoops compressing bent staves

shots.purpose: Cut in on the same side of the barrel, keeping its curving edge where the eye already is, then slide along the hoops and staves as they are named
shots.subject: barrel

transition.motivation: The narration names physical parts, so cut in to detail; the silhouette edge stays put across the cut

beats.purpose: Pay off the question: the bulge makes the barrel easy to roll and to turn

shots.purpose: Whip to the barrel lying on its side; push in low to show it touches the floor only at the bulge
shots.subject: barrel

shots.purpose: Cut on the shove: the barrel is already rolling on the first frame, and the camera follows at the same height and focus so the eye stays on it, so 'easy to roll' is felt, not just heard
shots.subject: barrel

transition.motivation: Cut on action: the roll starts on the cut, and a 50-degree swing turns the barrel's motion across the frame

shots.purpose: Rise and pull back as the barrel pivots on its bulge from the first frame, revealing how little floor it needs to turn
shots.subject: barrel

transition.motivation: Cut on action: the pivot starts on the cut as 'easy to turn' begins; a higher, wider view makes it readable
